meta.title: Raise a Material Creation intake request and trigger its approval workflow
gaps: No dedicated catalog step can navigate the Intake page, fill the Material Creation request fields, or directly verify the submitted intake's approval workflow status.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: No dedicated catalog step can navigate the Intake page, fill the Material Creation request fields, or directly verify the submitted intake's approval workflow status.

args.goal: open the Intake page, click Create Request, enter the request title "Add New Raw Material - HDPE Granules", select Request Condition "Material Creation", continue to Basic Details, fill Item Description, Item Type, Unit of Measure, Category and Subcategory, leave Material Code optional, review and confirm the auto-assigned approval chain, submit the intake, and stop on the screen showing that the intake was submitted and its approval workflow started

steps.note: No domain catalog step covers the Intake workflow, so perform the complete request creation and submission in the current buyer session.
Checks for the visible approval-workflow subject after submission; the label is not confirmed in the catalog.
